rules.applies_when: a part is selected replaced or reviewed
actions: verify ratings pins polarity package and lifecycle
acceptance: symbol pin package pin and datasheet pin agree
maximum project stress plus required margin does not exceed applicable rating
rules.failure_policy: mark part unresolved and block manufacture

rules.applies_when: a rail is created changed or reviewed
required_inputs: efficiency dropout ripple thermal and sequencing limits
actions: calculate worst-case current power loss and margin
verify startup shutdown and fault paths
acceptance: worst-case load is within component and source limits with project-approved margin
dropout and transient limits hold over stated range
thermal conclusion is measured or explicitly unverified
rules.failure_policy: block design approval when any required limit or source is unknown

rules.applies_when: clock or reset behavior affects boot
required_inputs: reset thresholds widths and power sequence
actions: verify component values and layout requirements
trace reset sources and default states
acceptance: clock network values derive from selected component source
minimum reset pulse and voltage sequence meet every connected device
unsafe output defaults are defined during reset
rules.failure_policy: hold hardware/software integration on unknown boot condition

actions: check VIH VIL VOH VOL and absolute maxima over conditions
acceptance: driver guaranteed output satisfies receiver guaranteed input with stated margin
no state violates absolute maximum or causes uncontrolled back-power
direction and default level match software contract
rules.failure_policy: mark interface CONFLICT and block connection release

rules.applies_when: an analog quantity is measured or conditioned
actions: verify settling and ADC drive requirements
check clipping common-mode and fault current
acceptance: full valid input range remains inside every stage limits
total stated worst-case error is within project requirement
missing contributor yields UNKNOWN rather than PASS
rules.failure_policy: block accuracy claim; preserve safe protection review

rules.applies_when: native schematic is reviewed or changed
acceptance: every waiver has reason owner scope and revision
saved project reopens and retains intended objects
rules.failure_policy: report NOT_RUN when tool unavailable and block tool-verified claim
